protocol.purpose: Measure dense APC-warm B8 whole-model opportunity on natural questions, not rerun failed sparse B8 dynamic kernel.
limitations: Baseline-only measurement; neither a candidate speedup nor formal quality result.
Fixed128 valid generation ignores EOS; same cap is not a guarantee of same cross-precision token work.
Graph profiling is separate from unprofiled wall measurements; no rank-time summation.
These two training documents do not establish general agent fanout or arrival distributions.
Root must freeze launch sources and resource accounting before use; no GPU was launched by this audit.

workers.scope: One frozen real B8 state; cached per-layer O is invalid for future positions. Optimistic intervention, not a deployable algorithm, natural trajectory, or strict mathematical upper bound.
limitations: Both timed paths call bare graph managers without per-step CPU identity hooks. CUDA-event graph intervals can include CPU launch gaps; AA and host times are retained.
Cached path still writes KV and copies saved O; graph dependency structure differs. Whole-model output is bitwise checked.
Only written KV slots are compared, not a full-cache checksum. No preparation cost is amortized into the diagnostic.
Witness/check graph copy overhead is excluded from paired graph timing.
